implementationReadiness.unchangedReason: The remaining readiness blocker is actual Unity 6000.3.0f1 compile/runtime verification. Foliage BRDF and QA changes are source-side risk reduction only.

problemFound.summary: The generated foliage path already had explicit geometry, two-sided transmission and causal canopy variation, but its direct specular term was an arbitrary power-lobe scalar without an explicit dielectric F0/Fresnel contract or controllable normal amplitude. That left a material-physicality gap capable of producing plastic/chrome-like leaf sparkle in grazing 4K light even though foliage metadata called the surface dielectric.
problemFound.physicalAnchor: Published plant-cell-wall refractive-index measurements around 1.415-1.425 imply normal-incidence dielectric F0 around 0.03 through ((n-1)/(n+1))^2. This is used only as a measured-order optical anchor, not as a species-specific measurement for the benchmark trees.
risk: plastic/chrome-like grazing sparkle inconsistent with a dry dielectric leaf
back-face lighting discontinuity under Cull Off
material metadata and actual shader response drifting apart

changes.purpose: Replaces the arbitrary leaf specular power lobe with dielectric Schlick Fresnel + isotropic GGX/Schlick-Smith direct specular, adds explicit F0 and normal scale, flips the shading normal on viewed back faces, and keeps transmission attenuated and energy-bounded.

Machine-readable natural-leaf material/construction reasoning, refractive-index/F0 basis, roughness/normal/transmission constraints, dry wetness and UV-aging policy, geometry-vs-material split, LOD policy and native-render review targets.

Applies and validates actual generated foliage materials at F0=0.03, normalScale=0.72, broad dry-leaf smoothness scales, bounded transmission, double-sided GI, instancing and no emission; validates active generated leaf renderer bindings and property-block transmission.
Makes measured-order foliage dielectric physicality a persisted quality-scene invariant once high-detail tree masters exist.
Requires foliage optical contract validation before native capture and actual foliage-material validation after the scored-scene rebuild/capture path.

expectedVisualScoreImpact: Material/PBR physical plausibility: actual leaf shader now has an explicit dry-dielectric F0/Fresnel model and constrained roughness/normal amplitude instead of a generic art-directed specular scalar.
Vegetation/natural complexity: close/grazing leaf clusters should have more coherent two-sided angular response while preserving explicit plant/branch geometry and canopy-context variation.

Lighting/shadows/reflections: foliage direct reflection and transmitted sunlight are tied to the same directional light attenuation and an explicit dielectric energy budget rather than self-lighting or painted highlights.

Temporal/LOD/aliasing stability: broad roughness and bounded normal amplitude reduce the expected risk of sub-pixel foliage sparkle; actual shimmer and LOD pop remain sealed temporal-evidence judgments and receive zero source-side Visual points.
